description: Tracés du réseau de transport ferré d'Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Description linéaire du réseau ferré d’Ile-de-France, avec mise en avant des lignes de Transport en Commun subventionnées par Ile-de-France Mobilités. Généalogie Les sources de cette donnée sont les éléments transmis par les transporteurs, ainsi que la BD TOPO de l'IGN et la photo aérienne pour les tronçons non souterrains. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Données géographiques, Réseau ferré, Lignes, IDG, geoidf. The portal shows 1,673 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-10-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
